facts: Requirement violated: Checkout totals must never be negative.
Failing assertion: Total must never be negative
After step 1 (Add "mug" to cart): subtotal $12.00, discount $0.00, total $12.00
After step 2 (Add "tee" to cart): subtotal $37.00, discount $0.00, total $37.00
After step 3 (Apply coupon FLAT20): subtotal $37.00, discount $20.00, total $17.00, message "Coupon FLAT20 applied."
After step 4 (Remove "tee" from cart): subtotal $12.00, discount $20.00, total -$8.00, message "Coupon FLAT20 applied."
analysis.disclaimer: Recommendation only. ProofFix has not modified, applied, or tested any of these changes. Verify before merging.

rootCause.summary: applyCoupon() stores `state.fixedDiscount = Math.min(coupon.value, subtotal())` once, at apply time. When the cart later shrinks, discountAmount() reuses the stale amount, so a $20 discount is subtracted from a $12 subtotal.
evidence: FLAT20 applied directly to a $12 cart is correctly capped (follow-up test), so the cap works at apply time.
After removing an item, discount stayed at $20.00 while subtotal dropped to $12.00.
discountAmount() adds `state.fixedDiscount` without recomputing against the current subtotal.
alternatives: The remove button could fail to re-render totals (ruled out: subtotal updated correctly; only the discount was stale).
rootCause.uncertainty: Low — the defect reproduced through two different cart-shrinking paths (remove and quantity 0).

primary.title: Recompute the fixed discount from current state
primary.approach: Derive the fixed discount inside discountAmount() from state.coupons and cap the total discount at the current subtotal; stop caching it in applyCoupon().
primary.why: Making the discount a pure function of the current cart removes the stale value that caused the negative total.
sideEffects: state.fixedDiscount becomes unused and should be removed from applyCoupon().

alternatives.title: Re-cap on every cart mutation
alternatives.how: Call a `recalcCoupons()` helper from addItem/setQuantity/removeItem that re-applies `Math.min(value, subtotal())`.
cons: Every future mutation must remember to call the helper
sideEffects: Missed call sites reintroduce the bug
alternatives.preferableWhen: Cached discount values are required elsewhere (e.g., analytics).
tests: Each mutation after a fixed coupon keeps total ≥ 0

alternatives.title: Guard the total and block checkout on invalid totals
alternatives.how: Clamp `total()` at 0 and have checkout() refuse orders whose total is negative.
pros: Protects R2 against any pricing bug
cons: Discount line still displays an incorrect value (R3)
alternatives.preferableWhen: As a last-line safety net in addition to the primary fix.
tests: checkout() with negative computed total is rejected

analysis.ranking: A derived (non-cached) discount fixes the root cause for all mutation paths; the alternatives either rely on discipline or only hide the symptom.
